================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO NA AFTER EFFECTS - NU YEYEWO
Version 9.2.9  -  Oktoba 2026
================================================================================

ANIME THEME yeye 33 kpe ɖe Demon Slayer tɔwo ŋu, themewo ƒe mouse nuwɔwɔwo dzena vavã
le After Effects me fifia, eye Theme Tiatia zu dropdown ɖeka si le ɖoɖo nu nyuie.

DO ŊGƆ NA NÈDZE EGƆME
- Ɖoe ɖe wò version si le asiwò fifia la dzi kple ZXP installer si nèzãna ɖaa, emegbe
  tu After Effects eye nàgaʋui zi ɖeka.
- Wò ɖoɖowo, theme, presets kple expressions siwo nèdzra ɖo la anɔ anyi.

YEYE: ANIME THEME 33
- Flex ƒe Ɖoɖowo > THEME TIATIA > PANEL ƑE THEME me ƒuƒoƒo ɖeka le anime ɖesiaɖe ŋu fifia:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) kple Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Character ɖesiaɖe ƒe nɔnɔme to vovo: nu si kplɔa wò mouse ɖo, amedzidzedze ne èzi
  button aɖe dzi, nu si dzɔna ne èlé miame ƒe button la ɖe te, kple explosion si dzɔna
  ne èlée ɖe te sekend 2.5 ene.
- Wole bɔbɔe abe Demon Slayer themewo ene: nuwɔwɔwo wɔa dɔ ne èʋuʋu mouse la alo
  ètia nu ko. Tsi DZIƑOƑO ƑE NUWƆWƆWO be amadedewo ko nanɔ anyi.

TRƆTRƆ: THEME TIATIA
- Demon Slayer cardwo siwo nɔ PANEL ƑE THEME te la meli o, eyata Flex ƒe Ɖoɖowo
  le kpuie wu. Tia theme ɖesiaɖe tso PANEL ƑE THEME dropdown la me; eʋuna ɖe theme
  si nèzãna la dzi.
- Kurama kple Baryon le Naruto ƒuƒoƒo la me fifia.

NU SIWO WOƉƆ
- Zi geɖe la, themewo ƒe mouse nuwɔwɔwo (tsi, dzo, dzikedzo kple bubuawo) medzena le
  After Effects me o, ne wotsi Ɖoɖo Bɔbɔe gɔ̃ hã. Ɣeyiɣi siwo me dɔ sɔ gbɔ ɖe panel la
  ŋutɔ dzi, kple dzedze gɔme si me dɔ sɔ gbɔ la, wobu be theme la ye nɔ blewu ɖem, eyata
  nuwɔwɔwo tsina le wo ɖokui si. Fifia, ne wò graphics card ye taa wo (kɔmpiuta geɖe
  me), ɣeyiɣi mawo naa nuwɔwɔwo bɔbɔna vie hena ɣeyiɣi kpui aɖe ko.

SI MEGATRƆ O
- License, activation kple link ɖesiaɖe wɔa dɔ abe do ŋgɔ ene tututu.
- Demon Slayer theme 11 la dzena abe le 9.2.8 me ene tututu.
- Tab kple tool bubu ɖesiaɖe wɔa dɔ abe le 9.2.8 me ene tututu.
================================================================================

  o. Fifia wodzena ɣesiaɣi.
- PANEL ƑE THEME dropdown la ate ŋu ayi edzi aɖe theme xoxo la ƒe ŋkɔ afia le theme la
  trɔtrɔ megbe. Fifia eɖea theme si le dɔ wɔm la fiana ɣesiaɣi.
